summary: stui describes click and right-click actions in its pointer footer, fills hover gaps and documents all pointer targets.

replay.detail: UI feedback and documentation only; no replay or projection rebuild.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordination requirements change.

compatibility.detail: Existing actions and menus are reused; World and client-v0 are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No manual action or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: No stored state transition or new recovery step is introduced.
